blocks.text: Podon mein teen qism ke meristems hote hain: apical meristems, intercalary meristems aur lateral meristems (kitab yahan Fig. 7.13 likhti hai; is se murad Figure 8.12 hai).

Apical meristems jaron aur shoots (tane ke oopar wale hisse) ke siron par hote hain. Pode ke jism ko lamba karna in ka asal kaam hai. Yeh hamesha barhne wale hisse (perpetual growth zones) hain jo jaron aur tanon ke siron par cells ki tadaad barhate hain. Primary growth mein in ka aham kirdar hai.

Intercalary meristems sire (apex) se permanent tissues ke zariye alag hote hain. Yeh ghaas jaise bohat se podon mein internodes (do gaanthon ke darmiyan wala hissa) ki bunyad (base) par hote hain aur patte aur phool banane mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. Yeh aarzi (temporary) hote hain.

Lateral meristems taqseem hone wale cells ke cylinders hain jo tane aur jar ke kinaron (peripheral regions) ke saath hote hain. Yeh tanon aur jaron ki motai (thickness) barhate hain. Yeh lakri wale (woody) podon mein hote hain aur secondary growth ke liye bohat zaroori hain. Lateral meristems ki do bari shaklein hain: vascular cambium aur cork cambium. Vascular cambium xylem aur phloem ke darmiyan hota hai aur secondary xylem aur secondary phloem banata hai. Cork cambium tanon aur jaron ki bahar wali teh mein banta hai. Yeh cork cells banata hai jo epidermis ki jagah le lete hain aur bahar ki hifazati chhaal (bark) banate hain.

blocks.alt: Ek naujawan pauda jis par lateral bud hai; teer shoot ke sire, tane aur jar ke sire se teen bare dabbon tak jate hain: shoot ka sira; tana khol kar Cork cambium aur Vascular cambium; aur jar ka sira jis mein shakh, Root hairs, Root apical meristem aur Root cap. Daen taraf shoot ke sire ka section (Leaf primordia, Lateral bud primordia; paimana 100 micrometre) aur jar ke sire ka section (Root apical meristem, Root cap; paimana 50 micrometre).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.12: Apical meristem pode ka primary jism aur lateral meristem secondary jism banata hai (kitab ki Figure 8.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Siron (tips) par apical meristems hain jo pode ko lamba karte hain: yeh primary plant body hai. Tane ke andar ke cambium (vascular aur cork) lateral meristems hain jo tane ko mota karte hain: yeh secondary plant body hai. Leaf primordia aur lateral bud primordia aage chal kar naye patte aur shakhein bante hain.
